count_criteria.repository_numeric_threshold_rows: Static application of repository.ts:172-183 null-coalesced admissionThreshold/sekemScore parsing, excluding parsed zero, before Map insertion. Not a current deployed SQLite/API count.

snapshot_authority.review_boundary: Inherited catalog/route changes are counted and hashed; their institutional eligibility/year assertions are not independently approved here.
